entities.summary: Jonathan Darryl Klemm is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman who played in the National Hockey League. As of 2018, he was an associate coach for the Winnipeg Ice of the Western Hockey League, formerly known as the Kootenay Ice which relocated from Cranbrook, British Columbia to Winnipeg before the 2019–20 season.
